name: Drink it Bitter
source:
It draws you into a suspended world, where a simple cup of coffee can turn out to be more bitter than you’d expect.

[From [url=https://jecopx.itch.io/drink-it-bitter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
它将你引入一个时间仿佛凝固的世界——在那里，一杯寻常的咖啡或许会尝出超乎想象的苦涩。

[摘自[url=https://jecopx.itch.io/drink-it-bitter]itch.io[/url]]
